method: Official docs, SDK source and first-person issue reports; general social snippets excluded from conclusions. Queries recorded in white paper.

sources.title: Google GenerateContent video guide
sources.relevance: Structured YouTube fileData; public-video limitations; static/agentic modes; clipping; MM:SS prompts; streaming. Not a guarantee of verbatim accuracy.

sources.title: Google structured output guide
sources.relevance: Subset support, maxItems and schema complexity. Application semantic validation remains necessary.

sources.title: Google pricing
sources.relevance: Gemini 3.8 Flash standard input/output rates, dated promotional pricing and cache rates.

sources.title: Google response API reference
sources.relevance: Token modality details and thought counts; prompt blocking and finish reasons. These are not accuracy measurements.

sources.title: Google troubleshooting
sources.relevance: Diagnose structured API errors rather than treating all HTTP400 as inaccessible media.

sources.title: YouTube captions download
sources.relevance: Requires permission to edit the video and OAuth. Ordinary API key is not arbitrary public-caption access.

sources.title: Google URL Context
sources.relevance: YouTube, audio and video unsupported by URL Context; use video input API.

sources.title: Google audio guide
sources.relevance: Transcription examples and separate dedicated speech-to-text service; does not prove our output exact.

sources.title: js-genai issue 1318
sources.relevance: Generic INVALID_ARGUMENT with Zod-derived schema; different version/date, not diagnosis of our failure.

sources.title: Progressive timestamp drift report
sources.relevance: User reports timing drift across models and a model-dependent tradeoff. Not our model/video; no causal transfer.

sources.title: Gemini 2.0 timestamp issue
sources.relevance: Forum response reports reproduction/escalation for that example. No current universal fix established.

sources.title: python-genai schema issue 1815
sources.relevance: Schema-path compatibility differences and recommendation to use response_json_schema; different SDK, not direct fix.

sources.title: js-genai implementation
sources.relevance: Schema backward-compatibility conversion; main is mutable, pinned installed SDK remains reproduction basis.

sources.title: WhisperX maintained repository
sources.relevance: Forced alignment/VAD alternative needs media bytes, language-specific models and separate compute; numeric alignment limitations.
